mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
